Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in La Verne for 2026, and here is what he found: 5 family events. The magic runs from December 5 (Brunch with Santa and Friends, and the Old Town La Verne Holiday Stroll) through the Winter Wonderland on December 12, plus A Crescendo Christmas at the Dailey Theater. The Holiday Extravaganza in neighboring San Dimas (December 5) adds a free parade and tree lighting. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in La Verne

  • 5 Christmas events for kids in La Verne
  • Free: free Santa photos at the Old Town La Verne Holiday Stroll (December 5, 3:30 to 5:30 pm); free status of the 3 live cards was not re-read, recount with quick-counts
  • Meet Santa: Brunch with Santa and Friends (December 5) and Santa photos at the Holiday Stroll (December 5)
  • Parades and tree lightings: the Holiday Story and Tree Lighting at the Holiday Stroll (December 5, 6 pm)
  • Trains: no holiday train ride in La Verne (see our California Christmas train rides guide)
  • Nearby in San Dimas: the Holiday Extravaganza in Downtown San Dimas (December 5, free admission, parade at 4 pm and tree lighting at 6 pm)
  • Season: December 5 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? La Verne families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Rancho Cucamonga, which covers Victoria Gardens Santa Photos and light shows, Snow Much Fun Day and The Nutcracker at the Lewis Family Playhouse.
